messages:
Rina Kapoor: Heads-up I opened a PR to refine the Private/VPC install docs: add short HSM rotation steps, air-gapped curl examples using local CA, and a note about nftables. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3901
Tom Evans: Thanks Rina. Quick read: can you avoid referencing plaintext key export anywhere? Also the curl example needs --cacert and --resolve for air-gapped installs.
Rina Kapoor: Yep, reworded the rotation steps to make it explicit that rotation is performed on the HSM and SDKs receive wrapped blobs only. Updated curl to: `curl --cacert /etc/redwood/ca.pem --resolve "hsm.internal:8443:10.2.1.5" -X POST https://hsm.internal:8443/api/keys/rotate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"key_id":"prod-01"}'`
Nate Li: Can we add an openssl check snippet to verify TLS from the installer VM? `openssl s_client -connect hsm.internal:8443 -CAfile /etc/redwood/ca.pem` — helps catch missing CA.
Rina Kapoor: Added openssl snippet and a short nftables example: `nft add rule inet redwood-internal tcp dport 8443 accept`. Left a note about persisting rules.
Tom Evans: Also call out vendor differences (some HSMs require UDP ephemeral ports). A one-line compatibility note should be enough.
Rina Kapoor: Added vendor-compat note and a one-line migration checklist backport: "Verify HSM connectivity and perform a test key rotation in preprod."
infra-bot: CI: docs lint and linkcheck running for PR #3901.
docs-bot: CI: linkcheck reported a missing image asset assets/network-topology-v3.png referenced in the guide.
Rina Kapoor: Fixed image name and pushed.
docs-bot: CI: all checks passed for PR #3901  4 files changed, 1 image renamed.
Tom Evans: LGTM from security (confirmed wording about wrapped keys). Nate: LGTM from infra once we ensure the nft example includes note about ephemeral UDP.
Nate Li: LGTM, thanks Rina.
Rina Kapoor: Merged after CI green. Backport to migration checklist included. :tada:
